metadata_correction_after_execution.reason: Renamed confirmation scope to record that prior fixed-intersection outcomes had already been exposed; no gate threshold, branch, scene cohort, or promotion arithmetic changed.

rule.threshold_rationale: 0.5 is the neutral probability boundary for official proposal quality and the majority-overlap boundary for field/proposal agreement; neither threshold was selected from target IoU

gate_interpretation.high_sam_quality: A strong official 2D proposal supplies extent authority, so independent LUDVIG agreement can veto identity false positives.
gate_interpretation.low_field_overlap: A proposal that disagrees with most coarse-field support is identity-uncertain, so a second region authority is required.
gate_interpretation.low_quality_high_overlap: The current proposal and field already agree while official proposal quality is weak; preserve Method-v1 rather than allow an uncertain sidecar to erode object extent.
